g.text: d Where the error comes from
Fig. 2. Model selection on TRAIN only: nested cross-validation (outer 5 folds × 3 seeds, inner 3 folds), both grouped by dependency_cluster_id. Blue =
a-priori models (design features only); purple = conditional models that need the observed stress effect S_vs_C (meta-regression moderator, not an ML
feature). Selection rule fixed in advance: lowest mean RMSE per category, simpler model if within 1 %. (d) Between-study variance dominates; it is not
explained by the reported design descriptors. [V5 (2026-11-20)]
